title: Semantic-Gadget Chaining on Open VLMs: How Many Hops Until Refusal Fails?

original_idea.body: Semantic-gadget chaining on open VLMs (extends arXiv:2603.09246): decompose harmful tasks into 2/3/4 benign gadgets, measure success vs chain length on small open VLMs, test a recompose-and-check defense.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Mapping compositional-attack length/success + a cheap defense addresses a hard-to-filter threat; concrete chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simplified gadget-chaining on 1-2 open VLMs + recompose defense; VLM/decomposition adds depth.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused length-vs-success curve + defense; building decomposed tasks adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open VLMs, out-of-lab, fuzzy intent-detection; independent-friendly.

novelty.reasoning: Chain-length/success characterization + recompose defense likely mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Gadget-chain length/success curve uncharacterized on open VLMs.
